My old department head, Tom—he retired back in 2019, moved down to Florida—we used to get lunch every other Thursday. I trusted Tom implicitly. I trusted the company. If a user submitted a ticket and said they didn't spill coffee on their laptop, even when the motherboard was clearly fried and smelled like hazelnut roast, I didn't assume some malicious intent. I just assumed they were embarrassed. I always gave people the benefit of the doubt. I assumed everyone was just trying to do their jobs, same as me.

And... and that's exactly why this current situation is so undeniable, which is what I keep trying to explain to you. I didn't go looking for this.
